name: MonarchRadioCardGroup
title: RadioCardGroup
wrapsNative: Button per card with a custom ButtonStyle, in a VStack or LazyVGrid
summary: One choice shown as selectable cards, each with a title and an optional description, icon and meta text.
whenToUse: For a few options that need a description or a price to choose between, such as plans.
whenNotToUse: For a short list of plain options use the standard Picker (see radio-group). For several independent choices use toggles with the checkbox style.
api: init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<SelectionValue?>, options: [MonarchRadioCardOption<SelectionValue>], columns: Int = 1)

struct MonarchRadioCardOption<Value: Hashable> { init(_ value: Value, title: String, description: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, meta: String? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false, details: [String] = []) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label of the group, already localised.

options.name: selection
options.description: The value of the chosen card, or nil for no choice yet.

options.name: columns
options.description: Cards per row on a regular width, from 1 to 3. One column on a compact width and at the accessibility text sizes.

states.name: unselected
states.description: A surface-coloured card with the default border and an empty circle.

states.name: selected
states.description: Accent-subtle fill, a 2-point accent border, the icon in the accent and a filled circle.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The emphasis background, or the accent-subtle hover colour when selected.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Subtle background, subtle border and the disabled text colour, for one card (isDisabled) or the group (disabled(_:)).

appearance: Cards with 12-point corners on the surface colour. The selected card uses the accent-subtle fill and the strong accent for its border, icon and mark.
platformNotes: The web builds on its RadioGroup and shows a radio in each card; iOS has no radio button, so each card is a button with the selected trait and a drawn mark. The web switches to one column under 40rem; iOS uses the horizontal size class and the accessibility text sizes. The web's invalid state is not offered.
accessibility: The group is a container named by label.
Each card is one button: the title is its label, the meta text and description are its value, and the chosen card has the selected trait.
The selection is also a filled mark and a heavier border, not colour alone.
The whole card is the touch target and is at least 44 points high.
Icons and the mark are hidden from VoiceOver.
Text scales with Dynamic Type and wraps; the meta text moves under the title when the row is too narrow.
edgeCases: A selection that matches no card shows no card as selected.
Choosing the selected card again keeps it selected; a choice cannot be cleared by the person.
Values must be unique within the group, because they identify the cards.
Cards in one row of a grid are not made equal in height.

examples.title: With meta and description
examples.template:
MonarchRadioCardGroup(
    {{label}},
    selection: $selected,
    options: [
        MonarchRadioCardOption({{options.0.value}}, title: {{options.0.title}}, description: {{options.0.description}}, meta: {{options.0.meta}}),
        MonarchRadioCardOption({{options.1.value}}, title: {{options.1.title}}, description: {{options.1.description}}, meta: {{options.1.meta}}),
        MonarchRadioCardOption({{options.2.value}}, title: {{options.2.title}}, description: {{options.2.description}}, isDisabled: {{options.2.disabled}}),
    ]
)
examples.code:
MonarchRadioCardGroup(
    "Delivery",
    selection: $selected,
    options: [
        MonarchRadioCardOption("standard", title: "Standard", description: "Arrives in 3 to 5 working days.", meta: "€4.90"),
        MonarchRadioCardOption("express", title: "Express", description: "Arrives the next working day.", meta: "€12.00"),
        MonarchRadioCardOption("pickup", title: "Pick up in store", description: "Not available for this order.", isDisabled: true),
    ]
)

examples.title: Icons, two columns and a disabled card
examples.code:
MonarchRadioCardGroup(
    "Region",
    selection: $region,
    options: [
        MonarchRadioCardOption(1, title: "Europe", systemImage: "globe.europe.africa"),
        MonarchRadioCardOption(2, title: "Americas", systemImage: "globe.americas"),
        MonarchRadioCardOption(3, title: "Asia Pacific", description: "Not available yet.", isDisabled: true),
    ],
    columns: 2
)
